description: This file defines a utility function `apiGet` to perform HTTP GET requests with automatic handling of authorization headers, URL construction, and tenant identification via organization ID. It is used within a frontend codebase to communicate with backend APIs.

methods.name: isAbsoluteUrl(url)
methods.description: Checks if a given URL is absolute (starts with http:// or https://).

methods.name: joinUrl(base, path)
methods.description: Joins a base URL and a relative path into a complete URL.

methods.name: apiGet(url, options = {})
methods.description: Performs a GET request to the specified URL, injecting authorization headers and appending organization_id query parameter if needed. Handles JSON and text responses, throws errors for non-OK responses.
